article.title: ICE spies on unions and enforces the Cuba blockade
article.author: Gary Wilson
article.content: The federal agents who searched Rep. Ilhan Omar’s home on Oct. 12 belong to the same agency that is seizing fuel bound for Cuba. The post ICE spies on unions and enforces the Cuba blockade appeared first on MR Online .
